Write a NONMEM control stream for a population PK model

Source: R/nm_write_ctl.R
nm_write_ctl.Rd

Builds a complete control stream ($PROBLEM to $TABLE) for a standard compartmental PK model: 1 to 3 compartments, IV or extravascular administration, first-order, zero-order (modelled rate or duration) or transit-compartment absorption, linear or Michaelis-Menten elimination, analytic (ADVAN/TRANS) or ODE solution. The $INPUT record follows the actual column order of the dataset when input is given.

Usage

nm_write_ctl(
  file = NULL,
  data = "data.csv",
  input = NULL,
  cols = NULL,
  cpts = 1L,
  route = c("EV", "IV"),
  absorption = c("first-order", "zero-order", "zero-order-d1", "transit"),
  transit_n = 2L,
  elimination = c("linear", "michaelis-menten"),
  dynamics = c("analytic", "ode"),
  ode_subroutine = c("ADVAN13", "ADVAN6"),
  error = c("additive", "proportional", "combined"),
  method = c("FOCEI", "FOCE", "FO", "LAPLACE", "LAPLACEI", "IMP", "ITS", "SAEM", "BAYES"),
  theta_init = NULL,
  theta_lower = NULL,
  theta_upper = NULL,
  theta_fix = NULL,
  iiv = NULL,
  iiv_scale = c("cv", "omega"),
  omega_structure = c("diagonal", "block"),
  omega_rho = 0.1,
  sigma_init = c(prop = 0.09, add = 0.01),
  sigma_fix = NULL,
  sigma_structure = c("auto", "diagonal", "block"),
  covariates = NULL,
  drop = NULL,
  ignore = NULL,
  npde_esample = 300L,
  npde_seed = 12334L,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  from = NULL,
  candidate = 1L,
  conc_factor = 1
)

Arguments

file

Output path. If NULL (default), nothing is written.

data

File name written in $DATA.

input

Dataset column names, in file order, or the path to the dataset (its first line is read). If NULL, $INPUT lists the mapped columns only.

cols

Named list mapping NONMEM roles (id, time, dv, amt, evid, mdv, cmt, rate) to column names. Missing roles are guessed from input; without input, standard names are used.

cpts

Number of compartments (1, 2 or 3).

route

"EV" (extravascular) or "IV".

absorption

For route = "EV": "first-order", "zero-order" (rate K0 estimated), "zero-order-d1" (duration D1 estimated) or "transit".

transit_n

Number of transit compartments.

elimination

"linear" or "michaelis-menten".

dynamics

"analytic" or "ode". Analytic is used only when an ADVAN exists for the model; otherwise ODE is used.

ode_subroutine

"ADVAN13" or "ADVAN6", written with TOL=9.

error

"additive", "proportional" or "combined".

method

Estimation method: "FO", "FOCE", "FOCEI", "LAPLACE", "LAPLACEI", "IMP", "ITS", "SAEM" or "BAYES". $COVARIANCE is added for FO, FOCE and Laplace methods. FO is written METHOD=ZERO (NONMEM does not accept METHOD=FO).

theta_init

Named numeric vector of initial values; defaults are used for the other parameters.

theta_lower, theta_upper

Named numeric vectors of bounds. The lower bound defaults to 0 and the upper bound to none; NA removes a bound.

theta_fix

Names of the parameters to fix at their initial value.

iiv

Interindividual variability (exponential ETA). NULL (default): an ETA on every structural parameter (CV 20%, 30% for absorption parameters). A character vector: ETAs on these parameters with default values. A named numeric vector: ETAs on these parameters with these values. character(0): no ETA.

iiv_scale

"cv" (values of iiv are CV%, converted exactly with OMEGA = log(1 + CV^2)) or "omega" (variances).

omega_structure

"diagonal" or "block" (one $OMEGA BLOCK).

omega_rho

Initial correlation of the $OMEGA BLOCK.

sigma_init

Named numeric vector c(prop = , add = ) of initial variances.

sigma_fix

Components to fix: any of "prop", "add".

sigma_structure

"auto", "diagonal" or "block" (combined error only).

covariates

Covariate names written in the cotab table.

drop

Column names written =DROP in $INPUT. For extravascular first-order or transit absorption, a mapped RATE column is dropped automatically.

ignore

Extra IGNORE conditions, e.g. "BQL.EQN.1".

npde_esample, npde_seed

ESAMPLE and SEED of the sdtab table (NPDE).

overwrite

Logical. Replace an existing file.

verbose

Logical. Print a message when the file is written.

from

Optional nm_model_suggestion object from nm_suggest_model(). The structure (cpts, route, absorption, transit_n, elimination, error), the initial values (theta_init, iiv, sigma_init) and the dataset (data, input) of candidate candidate are used for every argument not given explicitly. A lag time of the candidate is not written (no ALAG1 in this function): a message gives its value. When the structure is changed explicitly, only the initial values whose names exist in the new model are kept.

candidate

Candidate number in from (default 1).

conc_factor

Unit factor between amount/volume and the DV units: the scale is written S = V/conc_factor (e.g. 1000 for doses in mg, volumes in L and concentrations in ng/mL). Default 1 (S = V). With from, the dose_conc_factor of the suggestion is used, so that its initial values (volumes in L, KM in amount/L) match the DV units.

Value

An object of class nm_ctl (a character vector of control stream lines, printed as text), invisibly when file is given.

Details

Structural parameter names, used in theta_init, theta_lower, theta_upper, theta_fix and iiv:

  • elimination: CL (linear) or VMAX, KM (Michaelis-Menten);

  • central volume: V (1 compartment), V1 (IV or zero-order input, 2-3 compartments), V2 (first-order absorption, 2-3 compartments);

  • peripheral compartments: Q, V2 / Q2, V3, Q3 / V3, Q3, V4, Q4 (names of the matching ADVAN);

  • absorption: KA (first-order), K0 (zero-order rate, RATE = -1 in the dataset), DUR (zero-order duration D1, RATE = -2 in the dataset), MTT (mean transit time).

Combinations without an analytic solution (Michaelis-Menten elimination, transit compartments) are written with $DES and ode_subroutine, with TOL=9 on the $SUBROUTINES line (NM-TRAN requires TOL for these subroutines). Residual error uses ERR(1) (proportional) and ERR(2) (additive); the component absent from the chosen model is fixed to 0.

See also

nm_ctl_check(), nm_ctl_mu(), nm_ctl_iov(), nm_ctl_m3(), nm_suggest_model()

Examples

# One-compartment oral model with combined error
nm_write_ctl(error = "combined")
#> $PROBLEM 1cpt EV SUB/TRANS abs=first-order elim=linear
#> $INPUT ID TIME DV AMT EVID MDV CMT
#> $DATA data.csv IGNORE=@
#> $SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2
#> $PK
#> TVCL = THETA(1)
#> CL = TVCL*EXP(ETA(1))
#> TVV = THETA(2)
#> V = TVV*EXP(ETA(2))
#> TVKA = THETA(3)
#> KA = TVKA*EXP(ETA(3))
#> S2 = V   ; scale: concentration in the central compartment
#> 
#> $ERROR
#>   IPRED = F
#>   W     = SQRT(IPRED**2*SIGMA(1,1) + SIGMA(2,2))
#>   IF (W.EQ.0) W = 1
#>   IRES  = DV - IPRED
#>   IWRES = IRES/W
#>   Y     = IPRED + IPRED*ERR(1) + ERR(2)
#> 
#> $THETA ; initial estimates and bounds
#>   (0, 5)  ; CL
#>   (0, 50)  ; V
#>   (0, 1)  ; KA
#> 
#> $OMEGA 0.039 ; ETA(CL)
#> $OMEGA 0.039 ; ETA(V)
#> $OMEGA 0.086 ; ETA(KA)
#> 
#> $SIGMA 0.09 ; ERR(1) proportional
#> $SIGMA 0.01 ; ERR(2) additive
#> 
#> $ESTIMATION METHOD=COND INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5
#> $COVARIANCE PRINT=E MATRIX=S
#> 
#> $TABLE ID TIME AMT EVID MDV CMT DV PRED IPRED RES IRES WRES IWRES CWRES NPDE ESAMPLE=300 SEED=12334 NOAPPEND NOPRINT ONEHEADER FILE=sdtab
#> $TABLE ID ETA1 ETA2 ETA3 FIRSTONLY NOPRINT NOAPPEND ONEHEADER FILE=patab

# Two-compartment IV model, no IIV on Q, fixed V2, written to a file
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".ctl")
nm_write_ctl(f, route = "IV", cpts = 2,
             theta_init = c(CL = 3, V1 = 20), theta_fix = "V2",
             iiv = c(CL = 30, V1 = 25, V2 = 20), verbose = FALSE)
nm_ctl_check(f)
#> [OK] Check - No obvious inconsistency found by the static checks.

# From a data-driven suggestion
ex <- system.file("extdata", "example", "example_data.csv", package = "nmpilot")
s <- nm_suggest_model(ex, verbose = FALSE, design_eval = FALSE, max_profiles = 15)
nm_write_ctl(from = s, candidate = 1, verbose = FALSE)
#> $PROBLEM 1cpt EV SUB/TRANS abs=first-order elim=linear
#> $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV EVID MDV CMT WT GENO
#> $DATA example_data.csv IGNORE=#
#> $SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2
#> $PK
#> TVCL = THETA(1)
#> CL = TVCL*EXP(ETA(1))
#> TVV = THETA(2)
#> V = TVV*EXP(ETA(2))
#> TVKA = THETA(3)
#> KA = TVKA*EXP(ETA(3))
#> S2 = V   ; scale: concentration in the central compartment
#> 
#> $ERROR
#>   IPRED = F
#>   W     = SQRT(IPRED**2*SIGMA(1,1) + SIGMA(2,2))
#>   IF (W.EQ.0) W = 1
#>   IRES  = DV - IPRED
#>   IWRES = IRES/W
#>   Y     = IPRED + IPRED*ERR(1) + ERR(2)
#> 
#> $THETA ; initial estimates and bounds
#>   (0, 5.72)  ; CL
#>   (0, 55.6)  ; V
#>   (0, 1.11)  ; KA
#> 
#> $OMEGA 0.097 ; ETA(CL)
#> $OMEGA 0.116 ; ETA(V)
#> $OMEGA 0.693 ; ETA(KA)
#> 
#> $SIGMA 0.038 ; ERR(1) proportional
#> $SIGMA 0 FIX ; ERR(2) additive
#> 
#> $ESTIMATION METHOD=COND INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5
#> $COVARIANCE PRINT=E MATRIX=S
#> 
#> $TABLE ID TIME AMT EVID MDV CMT DV PRED IPRED RES IRES WRES IWRES CWRES NPDE ESAMPLE=300 SEED=12334 NOAPPEND NOPRINT ONEHEADER FILE=sdtab
#> $TABLE ID ETA1 ETA2 ETA3 FIRSTONLY NOPRINT NOAPPEND ONEHEADER FILE=patab
